2027-07-03.title: Dukhrana of Saint Thomas the Apostle
2027-07-03.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: God plants a garden in Eden, in the east
Keep hold of instruction, for she is your life
The household of God, built on the foundation of the apostles
It is to peace that God has called you
What God has joined together, let no one separate
2027-07-03.verse: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!” Jesus said to him, “Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have come to believe.”

2027-07-04.title: First Sunday of Kaitha: Feast of the Twelve Apostles
2027-07-04.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Elijah builds an altar of twelve stones
Many signs and wonders through the apostles
Be united in the same mind and the same purpose
Take the lowest place; invite the poor
2027-07-04.verse: For all who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.

2027-07-11.title: Second Sunday of Kaitha
2027-07-11.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The new covenant of love in the Spirit
The parable of the prodigal son
2027-07-11.verse: But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion; he ran and put his arms around him and kissed him.

2027-07-15.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The testing of faith produces endurance
Have faith in God; pray and forgive
Sts Kuriakose and Julitta · First Reading
Azariah prays in the midst of the furnace
Sts Kuriakose and Julitta · Second Reading
Stephen, full of grace and power, before the council (the calendar gives 6:8–7:10)
The faith of the ancient patriarchs (the calendar gives 11:3–10, 32–40 and 12:1–2)
Bear witness to the Lord before the people
2027-07-15.verse: “Everyone therefore who acknowledges me before others, I also will acknowledge before my Father in heaven.

2027-07-18.title: Third Sunday of Kaitha
2027-07-18.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: I rejoice because you felt a godly grief
A man born blind receives sight and faith
2027-07-18.verse: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

2027-07-25.title: Fourth Sunday of Kaitha
2027-07-25.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The law given through Moses: honour your father and mother
A people who did not turn to the one who struck them
Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord
Do not make void the word of God through your tradition
2027-07-25.verse: You abandon the commandment of God and hold to human tradition.

2027-07-01.title: Seventh Thursday of the Apostles
2027-07-01.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The light of the Gospel shines in the face of Christ
Woe to the teachers who lock people out and play with oaths
2027-07-01.verse: For it is the God who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

2027-07-02.title: Seventh Friday of the Apostles · The Seventy Disciples of Jesus · First Friday
2027-07-02.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: I will open rivers on the bare heights
Paul proclaims the promised Saviour at Antioch
Who will separate us from the love of Christ?
The cost of discipleship, and its reward
2027-07-02.verse: Whoever welcomes you welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.

2027-07-05.title: First Monday of Kaitha
2027-07-05.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: When you come together, is it really the Lord's supper?
Do the will of the Father
2027-07-05.verse: For I received from the Lord what I also handed on to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night when he was betrayed took a loaf of bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body that is for you. Do this in remembrance of me.”

2027-07-06.title: First Tuesday of Kaitha · Saint Maria Goretti
2027-07-06.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Be faithful with what the Lord has entrusted
2027-07-06.verse: Whoever is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much; and whoever is dishonest in a very little is dishonest also in much.

2027-07-07.title: First Wednesday of Kaitha
2027-07-07.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: My deeds give witness to me
2027-07-07.verse: My sheep hear my voice. I know them, and they follow me.

2027-07-08.title: First Thursday of Kaitha
2027-07-08.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The gift of the Spirit for the growth of the Church
2027-07-08.verse: Jesus said to them, “Very truly, I tell you, before Abraham was, I am.”

2027-07-09.title: First Friday of Kaitha · Saint James of Nisibis (Mar Yakob)
2027-07-09.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Wonders and signs through the apostles
2027-07-09.verse: do not fear, for I am with you, do not be afraid, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my victorious right hand.

2027-07-10.title: First Saturday of Kaitha
2027-07-10.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-07-10.verse: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

2027-07-12.title: Second Monday of Kaitha
2027-07-12.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The crown of life for those who endure the trial
Those who do the will of God enter the Kingdom
2027-07-12.verse: Blessed is anyone who endures temptation. Such a one has stood the test and will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.

2027-07-13.title: Second Tuesday of Kaitha
2027-07-13.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: A friend of the world becomes an enemy of God
2027-07-13.verse: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.

2027-07-14.title: Second Wednesday of Kaitha
2027-07-14.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Our inner nature is renewed day by day; a building from God
The grain of wheat that falls into the earth and dies
2027-07-14.verse: Very truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just a single grain; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

2027-07-16.title: Our Lady of Mount Carmel · Second Friday of Kaitha · Mar Mari, Disciple of Mar Addai
2027-07-16.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Our Lady of Mount Carmel · First Reading
Our Lady of Mount Carmel · Second Reading
Our Lady of Mount Carmel · Epistle
Participation in the sufferings and the consolation of Christ
Our Lady of Mount Carmel · Gospel
I made him a witness to the peoples (the calendar gives 55:4–13)
Those who believed were of one heart and soul (the calendar gives 4:32–5:11)
The apostle proclaims the risen Christ (the calendar gives 15:1–19)
The risen Christ appears to the apostles (the calendar gives 20:19–31)
2027-07-16.verse: But he said, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it!”

2027-07-17.title: Second Saturday of Kaitha
2027-07-17.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: God chose the poor to be heirs of the kingdom
Those who eat the bread of heaven are blessed: the great dinner
2027-07-17.verse: And the slave said, “Sir, what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.”

2027-07-19.title: Third Monday of Kaitha
2027-07-19.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Faith is brought to completion by works
2027-07-19.verse: For just as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is also dead.

2027-07-20.title: Third Tuesday of Kaitha
2027-07-20.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: A prophet is not accepted in his hometown
2027-07-20.verse: And a harvest of righteousness is sown in peace for those who make peace.

2027-07-21.title: Third Wednesday of Kaitha
2027-07-21.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: In Christ God reconciled the world to himself
2027-07-21.verse: So if anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation: everything old has passed away; see, everything has become new!

2027-07-22.title: Third Thursday of Kaitha · Saint Mary Magdalene
2027-07-22.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Who can separate us from the love of Christ?
Mary Magdalene proclaims the risen Christ
The prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well
Jesus sends out the twelve disciples
2027-07-22.verse: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord”; and she told them that he had said these things to her.

2027-07-23.title: Third Friday of Kaitha
2027-07-23.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Christ dwells in your hearts through faith
Jesus heals a blind man at Bethsaida
2027-07-23.verse: and that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, as you are being rooted and grounded in love.

2027-07-24.title: Third Saturday of Kaitha
2027-07-24.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Whoever is not against you is for you
2027-07-24.verse: Instead you ought to say, “If the Lord wishes, we will live and do this or that.”

2027-07-26.title: Fourth Monday of Kaitha · Saint Joachim and Saint Anne
2027-07-26.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: What is impossible for mortals is possible for God
Sts Joachim and Anne · First Reading
Sts Joachim and Anne · Second Reading
The genealogy of Jesus the Messiah
2027-07-26.verse: He raises up the poor from the dust; he lifts the needy from the ash heap, to make them sit with princes and inherit a seat of honor. For the pillars of the earth are the Lord’s, and on them he has set the world.

2027-07-27.title: Fourth Tuesday of Kaitha
2027-07-27.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Be patient until the coming of the Lord
The coming of the Son of Man
2027-07-27.verse: You also must be patient. Strengthen your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is near.

2027-07-28.title: Fourth Wednesday of Kaitha · Saint Alphonsa of the Immaculate Conception
2027-07-28.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Crucified in weakness, alive by the power of God
The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few
Suffering that leads to the kingdom of God
Unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies
2027-07-28.verse: Very truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just a single grain; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

2027-07-29.title: Fourth Thursday of Kaitha · Saint Martha
2027-07-29.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: I came to bring fire to the earth
Whoever lives in love lives in God
Jesus, the resurrection and the life
2027-07-29.verse: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Those who believe in me, even though they die, will live, and everyone who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

2027-07-30.title: Fourth Friday of Kaitha
2027-07-30.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The lowly boast in being raised up; the rich will fade like the flower
2027-07-30.verse: He said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ This is the greatest and first commandment. And a second is like it: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

2027-07-31.title: Fourth Saturday of Kaitha · Saint Ignatius of Loyola
2027-07-31.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Those who refused to love the truth
Do everything for the glory of God
A disciple must give up everything
2027-07-31.verse: So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do everything for the glory of God.
